name: congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency
description: A very rare form of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) characterized by glucocorticoid deficiency, hypergonadotrophic hypogonadism and severe hypokalemic hypertension.
